name: Care Overmuch
overview: The passages in Luke 14:18-20 illustrate how excessive concern for earthly matters, such as property, possessions, and personal relationships, can become a barrier to following Christ wholeheartedly. These excuses reveal the vain and useless nature of overcare for temporal things, which should be cast aside in trust of God's providential goodness and promises. Scripture warns believers that such care is unbecoming and obstructive to the Gospel, urging saints to be free from this burden by relying fully on God.
